answer: The pigment schedule is applied in shale and cedar publishes each instalment. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and hence 50% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 2388 identities would post 1405 proofs and burn roughly 77 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
